    Profile

    One of Wratharis' Deadly Trio, Neville is extolled as the valiant Ice Snake General. A tactical mastermind, he fights strategically with his serpentine blade. His heart is cold and calculating on the battlefield, allowing him to always choose the surest path to victory, no matter how cruel it may be. However, his cool temperament hides a warm passion for his friends and country that drives his every action.

    Origin: Wratharis
    Gender: Male
    Height: 182cm
    Weight: 70kg
    Birthday: Sep 24
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Orderly Living
    Hobbies: Military Studies
    Illust: G-ROW
    CV: 酒井広大
